The Carnot efficiency is the maximum possible theoretical efficiency of the power plant.

16c

During a Carnot cycle there are two isothermal processes, during which temperature must remain unchanged.

To ensure that the temperature remains unchanged, these processes would have to be conducted very slowly, making the cycle impractical for a real heat engine.
